_note: Seeded synthetic case history. Migrated from the hardcoded registry that used to live in session.js. Officer actions, dates, signature counts and identities here are all simulated — no live government system was touched.

cases.title: Road damage, Rajnagar Ward 4
cases.summary: A 40-metre stretch of broken surface after the first rain, with two earlier repairs in the same spot.

asks.q: Which stretch is worst near you?
asks.hint: A landmark is enough — the school turning, the handpump, the bus stop.
asks.ph: Example: the 40 m before the primary school gate

asks.q: Has this road caused you a loss or an injury?
asks.hint: A fall, a damaged vehicle, an ambulance or school van that could not pass.
asks.ph: Example: my scooter axle broke on 4 August

cases.title: Water supply interruption
cases.summary: Supply failing four days a week, with nothing after 7 am on the days it does come.

asks.q: How many days a week does your supply fail?
asks.hint: And roughly at which hours, if there is a pattern.
asks.ph: Example: four days a week, nothing after 7 am

asks.q: Where are you getting water from meanwhile?
asks.hint: A tanker, a neighbour's connection, a handpump, purchased cans.
asks.ph: Example: buying two 20-litre cans a day

cases.title: Burnt-out transformer, Kanjhawala feeder
cases.summary: Eleven streets on one feeder, worst stretch nine hours a day, mostly overnight.

asks.q: How many hours a day is your supply out?
asks.hint: Give the worst stretch you have had this week.
asks.ph: Example: 9 hours, mostly 6 pm to 3 am

asks.q: Has the outage damaged anything or stopped work?
asks.hint: A burnt appliance, spoiled stock, a shop or clinic that had to close.

cases.title: Street lights out, NH-44 km 118 to 121
cases.summary: Three kilometres unlit including the service road entry and the crossing.

asks.q: Which km marker do you use, and at what time?
asks.hint: The bend, the service road entry, the crossing you take after dark.
asks.ph: Example: km 119 service road entry, around 8 pm daily

asks.q: Have you seen a crash or a near miss on this stretch?
asks.hint: A date and what happened is enough. Say no if you have not.
asks.ph: Example: two-wheeler hit the divider on 12 May

cases.title: Anganwadi kendra roof, Barkheda village
cases.summary: Roof unusable since June; children sitting outside, no meal on rain days.

asks.q: How many children from your household attend the kendra?
asks.hint: And whether they have stopped going because of the building.
asks.ph: Example: two children, both kept home since June

asks.q: What are the children doing now instead?
asks.hint: Sitting outside, sent to another kendra, or not attending at all.
asks.ph: Example: sitting under the neem tree; no meal on rain days

stats._source: DARPG monthly CPGRAMS report, March 2026 (PIB PRID 2252591) and April 2026 figures. Real published data.
